# PARIKSHIT CLINIC — Dental, Periodontics & Facial Aesthetics
> Specialist dental practice and facial aesthetics clinic in Vadodara, Gujarat, India, directed by Dr. Jinal Parmar (BDS, MDS Periodontology, FFAC).

## Clinical Leadership & Credentials
- Lead Clinician: Dr. Jinal Parmar
- Medical Qualifications: BDS (Bachelor of Dental Surgery), MDS (Master of Dental Surgery in Periodontology & Oral Implantology), FFAC (Fellowship in Facial Aesthetics & Cosmetology)
- Medical Council Registration: Gujarat Dental Council (GDC) Registration No. A-20290
- Practice Specialization: Periodontal flap surgery, regenerative bone grafting, precision dental implants, smile makeovers, and medical-grade facial cosmetology (HydraFacial, PRP therapy).
- Clinical Approach: Evidence-based, conservative, gentle, biologically restorative care with dedicated 30-minute consultation windows.

## Department 1: Dental & Periodontal Procedures
- [Routine Exams](https://parikshit.space/services/routine-exams): Comprehensive dental assessment, periodontal screening, and digital radiography when clinically indicated.
- [Teeth Cleanings](https://parikshit.space/services/teeth-cleanings): Professional ultrasonic scaling, plaque removal, and tooth polishing for gingival wellness.
- [Dental Fillings](https://parikshit.space/services/dental-fillings): Tooth-colored composite resin restorations for decayed, fractured, or worn enamel.
- [Tooth Extractions](https://parikshit.space/services/tooth-extractions): Atraumatic removal of severely damaged, non-restorable, or impacted teeth under local anesthesia.
- [Emergency Dentistry](https://parikshit.space/services/emergency-dentistry): Rapid relief for acute toothache, cracked teeth, lost restorations, or soft-tissue dental trauma in Vadodara.
- [Pediatric Dentistry](https://parikshit.space/services/pediatric-dentistry): Child-friendly preventive exams, fluoride application, cavity fillings, and gentle deciduous pulpectomy.
- [Root Canal Treatment](https://parikshit.space/services/root-canal-treatment): Endodontic therapy to remove infected pulp, sterilize canals, and salvage natural teeth.
- [Crowns & Bridges](https://parikshit.space/services/crowns-bridges): Custom zirconia and ceramic crowns and fixed multi-unit bridges to restore biting function.
- [Dentures](https://parikshit.space/services/dentures): Complete and partial removable prosthetics tailored for masticatory function and facial support.
- [Dental Implants](https://parikshit.space/services/dental-implants): Titanium implant placement for permanent, biologically stable tooth replacement.
- [Gum Flap Surgery](https://parikshit.space/services/flap-surgery): Specialist periodontal pocket reduction and open-flap debridement by Dr. Jinal Parmar (MDS).
- [Bone Grafting](https://parikshit.space/services/bone-grafting): Regenerative biomaterial placement to rebuild alveolar ridge volume for implants and periodontally compromised teeth.
- [Gingivectomy](https://parikshit.space/services/gingivectomy): Surgical contouring of hypertrophic or uneven gum margins for periodontal health and aesthetics.
- [Scaling & Root Planing](https://parikshit.space/services/scaling-root-planing): Deep subgingival debridement and cementum smoothing to arrest active chronic periodontitis.
- [Crown Lengthening](https://parikshit.space/services/crown-lengthening): Periodontal tissue and bone recontouring to expose sound tooth structure for prosthetic crowns.
- [Frenectomy](https://parikshit.space/services/frenectomy): Gentle surgical release of restrictive labial or lingual frena (tongue-tie or lip-tie).
- [Teeth Whitening](https://parikshit.space/services/teeth-whitening): Safe in-office dental bleaching to lighten extrinsic and intrinsic dental discoloration.
- [Composite Bonding](https://parikshit.space/services/composite-bonding): Direct artistic sculpting of tooth-colored composite resin for chipped, spaced, or uneven teeth.
- [Porcelain Veneers](https://parikshit.space/services/porcelain-veneers): Ultra-thin handcrafted ceramic laminates bonded to anterior teeth for a harmonious smile.
- [Splinting](https://parikshit.space/services/splinting): Stabilization of hypermobile teeth resulting from advanced periodontitis or traumatic dental injury.
- [Abscess Drainage](https://parikshit.space/services/abscess-drainage): Urgent therapeutic decompression and antibacterial cleansing of acute periodontal or periapical swellings.
- [Night Guards](https://parikshit.space/services/night-guards): Custom-fabricated occlusal splints to protect dentition from sleep bruxism and alleviate TMJ strain.
- [Sports Mouthguards](https://parikshit.space/services/sports-mouthguards): Shock-absorbing protective mouthpieces tailored for athletes to prevent facial and dental trauma.

## Department 2: Facial Aesthetics & Cosmetology Procedures
- [HydraFacial Treatment](https://parikshit.space/services/hydrafacial-treatment): Multi-step clinical vortex extraction, exfoliation, and antioxidant hydration for radiant facial skin.
- [Face PRP Treatment](https://parikshit.space/services/face-prp-treatment): Autologous Platelet-Rich Plasma micro-injections to stimulate facial collagen, elasticity, and dermal regeneration.
- [Hair PRP Treatment](https://parikshit.space/services/hair-prp-treatment): Targeted scalp platelet therapy to activate miniaturized follicles and combat androgenetic hair thinning.
- [Chemical Peel](https://parikshit.space/services/chemical-peel): Dermatological acid peels (glycolic, salicylic, lactic) for hyperpigmentation, acne scars, and cell renewal.
- [Dermaplaning](https://parikshit.space/services/dermaplaning): Surgical blade exfoliation removing dead stratum corneum cells and vellus peach fuzz.
- [Microneedling](https://parikshit.space/services/microneedling): Precision collagen induction therapy to refine texture, reduce pores, and soften acne scarring.
- [Carbon Laser Peel](https://parikshit.space/services/carbon-laser-peel): Q-switched laser peeling with liquid carbon paste for pore tightening and sebum regulation.
- [Plasma Pen Skin Tightening](https://parikshit.space/services/plasma-pen-skin-tightening): Fibroblast sublimation technology to firm lax periorbital skin, eyelids, and superficial lines.
- [Mesotherapy](https://parikshit.space/services/mesotherapy): Micro-infusion of vitamins, minerals, and hyaluronic acid into the mesoderm for skin rejuvenation.
- [Laser Skin Rejuvenation](https://parikshit.space/services/laser-skin-rejuvenation): Non-ablative laser light therapy targeting photoaging, sunspots, and uneven tone.
- [Eyelid Xanthelasma Removal](https://parikshit.space/services/eyelid-xanthelasma-removal): Controlled cosmetic clearance of periocular cholesterol deposits with minimal scarring.
- [Milia & Skin Tag Removal](https://parikshit.space/services/milia-skin-tag-removal): Hyfrecation or sterile enucleation of benign cutaneous tags, keratin cysts, and milia.
